name: Starshatter stuns enemies in its line and applies a Scattered Star (#3196)
contract: Starshatter 801135 reads "sending forth Elune's astral light in a line outward from you, stunning enemies struck for 5 sec and applying a Scattered Star". The report says no server handler exists because grep finds no module reference to 801135, which is true and is not the same as the spell doing nothing: the record chain is native. 801135 Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_APPLY_AURA 23 (periodic trigger spell), amplitude 250 ms, DurationIndex 36 (1000 ms), trigger 707724; 707724 Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL on TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT casting 707725; 707725 (family 20) is a persistent area aura with a 500 ms dynamic object of radius 4 yd (SpellRadius 26) whose periodic trigger (amplitude 499) casts 712461; 712461 Effect[0] is aura 12 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN) with DurationIndex 28 (5000 ms) and Effect[1] triggers 804378 Scattered Stars. Only a run can show whether the chain fires, so the scenario asserts the tooltip's two clauses on a hostile creature 6 yd in front of the caster (location o 0 faces +X): the stun aura 712461 is present with a remaining duration between 3000 and 5000 ms when first observed, and the caster owns at least one stack of 804378 on the creature. A creature at the same distance beside the line is not tested. The fixture is level 80 with raised spell and ranged hit rating so a resist does not read as a missing effect; training dummies are faction 7 and would not be enemies, so the creature uses the harness default hostile faction 14.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The stun lasts up to 5 seconds
The creature carries a Scattered Star owned by the caster
